title: Calibrated Reading of Latent Reasoning and Communication
abstract: arXiv:2611.32143v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Latent reasoning and key-value communication store intermediate information in continuous representations, limiting direct inspection of model behavior. Existing activation readers trade the low cost of task-specific probes against the flexibility of language-model decoders. We propose the Calibrated Latent Reader, CLR, a compact transformer that predicts reasoning outcomes and message content through task-conditioned interactions between states and candidate answers. Source adapters support transfer across models, while conformal calibration provides coverage and false-alarm guarantees under exchangeability. On two CODI models, CLR improves accuracy over MLP and attention probes by 4-18 percentage points for final-answer prediction and reference-value membership. On CODI-GPT-2, it achieves accuracy comparable to a 1.7B LatentQA-based verbalizer using 437-648 times fewer inference FLOPs. On synthetic Qwen3-4B communications, comparing

translated_title: 潜空间推理与通信的校准化读取
translated_abstract: 潜推理与键值通信将中间信息存储在连续表示中，限制了对模型行为的直接检查。现有的激活读取器在任务特定探针的低成本与语言模型解码器的灵活性之间进行权衡。我们提出了校准潜读取器（Calibrated Latent Reader，CLR），这是一个紧凑的Transformer，通过状态与候选答案之间的任务条件化交互来预测推理结果和消息内容。源适配器支持跨模型迁移，而保形校准在可交换性条件下提供覆盖率与误报保证。在两个CODI模型上，CLR在最终答案预测和参考值隶属判断任务中比MLP和注意力探针的准确率提高了4-18个百分点。在CODI-GPT-2上，它以减少437-648倍推理FLOPs的代价，实现了与基于1.7B参数LatentQA的言语化器相当的准确率。在合成的Qwen3-4B通信上，比较（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出校准潜读取器（CLR），一个紧凑的Transformer，通过任务条件化交互、源适配器迁移与保形校准，以比语言模型解码器低数百倍的计算成本准确读取潜推理结果与键值通信内容，并提供统计覆盖率与误报保证。
en_tdlr: CLR is a compact transformer that accurately reads latent reasoning outcomes and key-value message content at 437-648x fewer inference FLOPs than decoder-based verbalizers, offering cross-model transfer via source adapters and coverage/false-alarm guarantees via conformal calibration.
